data.narrative:
Saronic is a Series D frontier-tech company in Defense & Security founded by Dino Mavrookas, Rob Lehman, Vibhav Altekar, and Doug Lambert. The company has raised $2.6B+ and carries a current post-money valuation of $9.25B. The relevant comp universe consists of 10 comparable companies: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private-market participants including Helsing, Chaos Industries, Onebrief, Anduril Industries, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods triangulate a defensible range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier to the last post-money round of $4.0B, yielding $6.0B. Peer-median analysis references three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Helsing at $18.0B, Chaos Industries at $4.5B, and Onebrief at $2.1B. The peer cohort median stands at $4.5B, with a wide range spanning $2.1B to $18.0B, reflecting heterogeneity in Defense & Security Series D valuations.

The triangulated analysis produces a low-to-high range of $3.8B to $6.9B, with a median of $5.2B. The current $9.25B valuation sits materially above both derived methods. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion within the peer set—particularly the $18.0B outlier—and limited public market comparability in this nascent sector. The gap between current valuation and triangulated range warrants scrutiny of Saronic-specific revenue growth, unit economics, or proprietary defensibility relative to peers.
